name: Alcaldía de Santa Marta
body: HSTS, nosniff, a strict Referrer-Policy, framing limited to its origin, and GA4. But the home page still runs ga('create', 'UA-121052958-1'), and Universal Analytics stopped processing data by July 2024.
lesson: Delete the UA snippet and keep GA4. One live tag is easier to trust than two half-dead ones.
summary: www.santamarta.gov.co scores 77 out of 100 (C). 1 check fails now, 25 are at risk, and 15 pass. Fix first: 204 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme.

fix.title: 204 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme
fix.evidence: In /sitemap.xml: santamarta.gov.co (204). The sitemap should list only URLs on https://www.santamarta.gov.co.
fix.fix: Regenerate the sitemap with the production https host.

fix.title: 78 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 20 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /accesibilidad, /pqrsd, /visita-santa-marta and 16 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages read. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 20 indexable pages are missing from the sitemap
fix.fix: Add them to the sitemap or regenerate it on each deploy.

fix.title: Universal Analytics code is still on the page
fix.evidence: Google stopped processing Universal Analytics data in July 2024. The code adds weight and collects nothing.
fix.fix: Remove the UA- tag and keep GA4.

AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
